design: Frozen multi-anchor128 dictionary. ScalarTop32 versus four greedily selected groups maximizing uncovered squared coordinate energy; six overlapping task8atom groups, one noun1atom group, sixteen background8atom groups. Two column-permuted memberships preserve group sizes and overlap structure. Each group arm has a scalar control with exactly its active atom count per state. All encoders use only that state; paired edits subtract independently reconstructed endpoints. Shared atoms decoded once.
evaluation: All old original-six non-discovery context states, retaining native failures as diagnostic; all80 H1002states with native-gate eligibility; all256 H998confirmation states from64documents, fourpositions each. No original whole-task holdouts evaluated. Paired edits include old contexts and new action pairs only; nuisance pairs excluded.
metrics: KL(native || reconstructed), native-top1 agreement, centered squared-error ratio. Macro average old native-passing cohorts and natural documents. Natural top1 agreement is fidelity, not ground-truth accuracy.
limits: Frozen dictionary and hard energy routing, not trained BSF encoder. Four selected groups can have different union dimensions; compare each to its per-state scalar budget control. Matched scalar budgets depend on group selector counts, not task labels. Native failures retained diagnostically. No fitting or task-aware routing.
